-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2.1.1   The opening town
**********************************

  Opponents:
  Rat (#1), Bat (#2), Slime (#3), a much longer creature name (#4), Another
  Thing (#5)

The town sits at the edge of the map and nobody in it seems to care about the
war happening far to the south. You arrive at night, which is a dead give-
away that something is about to go wrong.

Preparation: Put everyone in the Back Row. Magic attacks ignore the row, so
there is no downside yet.

Monster formations:
Rat
Rat, Rat (10/16)
Bat, Slime (6/16)

Item Shop:
Potion                 50
Ether                1500
Silver Spectacles     500
 There's really not anything that you need to buy here. You could buy a Tent
or two if you have the money.

This is _Sample_Quest_ and it covers *everything* you need. See
http://www.example.com/guide for more.

Old Man: Where are you going at this hour? The mines are closed until the
morning shift arrives.
Hero: I know.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2.1.2   The battle with the Golem
**********************************

Golem
Level: 4, HP: 50000, MP: 120
Steal: Nothing (always), Win: Ether (always)
Attacks: Megavolt

Two bears initially protect the Golem; you can't harm him until you
have killed both bears. They attack physically only.

You'll get two options:
         Toss it in the trash.
         Leave it.
If you toss it, nothing happens.
